company.name: Apptio
company.shortDescription: Apptio is a provider of SaaS-based Technology Business Management (TBM) solutions for managing businesses in the IT field.
company.description:
Apptio is the leading provider of cloud-based Technology Business Management (TBM) software that helps CIOs manage the business of IT.

Apptio’s suite of applications use business analytics to provide facts and insights about technology cost, value, and quality, so IT leaders can make faster, data-driven decisions. The purpose-built applications help companies align technology spend to business outcomes and automate IT processes like cost transparency, benchmarking, showback/chargeback, operational efficiency, and planning. Powering Apptio’s applications is a next generation, in-memory cost analytics platform that takes data directly from all financial, operational, and billing systems, and powers applications that give customers deep insight.
